=== a function with lines
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl _f
_f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	add -8, sp
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	mov 5, r10
	movea 0x1234, r10, r10
	.loc 1 5 3 is_stmt 0
	jarl _g, lp
	.loc 1 6 1 epilogue_begin
	add 8, sp
	jmp [lp]
=== branches that relax
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
_f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	br .L2
	.skip 300
.L2:
	.loc 1 4 0
	bz .L3
	.skip 40
.L3:
	.loc 1 5 0
	jmp [lp]
=== DWARF 5 as a compiler writes it
	.file 0 "/build" "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.file 1 "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.text
_f:
	.loc 1 5 21
	nop
	.loc 1 6 3
	jmp [lp]
